title: CNMD - Hydrant schema
description: A fire hydrant connected to a drinking water supply network, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be Hydrant.

beginLifespanVersion.description: Property. Start of the real-world version of the entity. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

endLifespanVersion.description: Property. End of the real-world version of the entity. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

category.description: Property. List of categories associated with the hydrant, compatible with Point of Interest (POI) systems. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

connectedTo.description: Relationship. Pipe to which the hydrant is connected.

criticalInfrastructure.description: Property. Specifies whether the hydrant is critical infrastructure. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

flowRate.description: Property. Maximum flow rate of the hydrant. Units:'LTM'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

geographicalName.description: Property. Official name information of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

hydroId.description: Property. Hydrographic identifier associated with the component, used to reference relevant hydrological systems or entities.

image.description: Property. Images of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

installationDate.description: Property. Installation date of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

lastInspectionDate.description: Property. Date of the last inspection. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

license.description: Property. License associated with the data. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for the maintenance of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

manufacturer.description: Property. Manufacturer of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

model.description: Property. Model of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

pressure.description: Property. Typical pressure at the hydrant. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

quality.description: Property. Observed quality of the network component, where 5 is excellent. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Unique code identifying the network to which the component belongs.

status.description: Property. Operational status of the hydrant. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency at which the data is updated. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

version.description: Property. Version of the data model. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
